Each output now states the primary form face check date (2026-10-21) separately from the companion faces and statutes (2026-09-07), and the 072B/072D receipts record officialFacesReadOn per document.
resolvedFindings.verifiedBy: Every page of all 58 outputs compared with the 6f6c30bb4 outputs: exactly one page per output differs and it is the date page; all 58 form pages are pixel-identical; each printed date equals a receipt field; fetch logs under review-evidence/storage/md-forms-oct2026-20261021 and ga20-source-inputs-20261021 show the bound 072A/072B/072D bytes fetched on 2026-10-21.

resolvedFindings.summary: The A46 072A Case Number widget [446.4,750.3,575.3,763.3] reached into the printed 'City/County' caption, so on all 15 md_10105 outputs the written case number touched the caption glyphs (0.12 pt at 600 dpi).
